entities.name: Antipater of Bostra
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antipater of Bostra was a Greek prelate who served as Metropolitan bishop of Bostra in the Roman province of Arabia and was one of the foremost critics of Origen. He lived in the 5th century AD.
